follow-up time: Until birth for those who became pregnant
outcome: Conversion to multiport or open myomectomy
cohort: 502 patients who underwent SPLM for symptom relief or growing myomas between October 2009 and April 2020.
finding: SPLM seems to be an effective procedure with good operative and postoperative obstetric outcomes for women with myomas who require surgery and may wish to subsequently become pregnant.
mod_finding: The 39 live births predominantly involved full-term delivery (36/39, 92.3%), mostly through cesarean section (36/39, 92.3%).
